row.notes: Evaluates the first derivative of a uniform cubic B-spline segment from 4 consecutive 16-byte control points at (+0x10)[segIndex..segIndex+3] using weights (-3t^2+6t-3)/6, (9t^2-12t)/6, (-9t^2+6t+3)/6, 3t^2/6. Handles degenerate repeated points: first three equal and t < 0.05 uses normalized P3-P2, last three equal and t > 0.95 uses normalized P1-P0, all four equal returns constant 0x145be8360. With fewer than 4 points or index out of range returns (1,0,0,0). Result is not normalized in the general case.
